Subject/action/sign→remembered event/person/concept relation; not equivalent to celebration.
Entity/resource is shared with another participant/group; distinct from ownership and transfer.
Directed sharer→co-user/recipient/resource relation.
Subject/state poses risk to another entity/activity; broader probabilistic relation than explicit threat.
Inverse risk relation.
Source/resource→device/process relation; distinct from generic provision or function.
Inverse energy-source relation.
Agent/force→object directional force relation.
Agent/force→object directional force relation distinct from pushing.
Inverse push relation.
Inverse pull relation.

Directional speed comparison.
Inverse speed comparison.
Subject→rank/order position relation; distinct from social status and sequence.
Directional rank comparison.
Inverse rank comparison.
Subject/entity→geographic origin relation; narrower than generic source/origin.
Directed social-emotional support relation; distinct from generic help, care, or conveyed emotion.
Agent→recipient/action encouragement relation; distinct from command, help, and communication.
Directed social response to another's achievement/event.
Directed social-contact/communication relation marking encounter or welcome.
Directed gratitude-expression relation; distinct from conveyed emotion alone.
Agent→offer/entity/condition acceptance relation.
Agent→offer/request/entity rejection relation; semantic counterpart to acceptance.
Attention relation broader than visual OBSERVES_LOOKS_AT; can target nonvisual concepts/events.
Subject/action/sign→remembered referent relation; related to but broader than commemoration.
Agent→future event/state expectation relation; distinct from temporal ordering.
Competitor→contest/opponent victory relation; narrower than competition/opposition.
Inverse defeat relation.
Manager/controller→managed entity/process relation; distinct from social-power control and device operation.
Entity/agent→model/source imitation relation; distinct from resemblance.
Artifact/entity→original relation; structural provenance distinct from general derivation.
Protector→protected entity against threat relation; narrower than generic PROTECTS.
Inverse guard/defense relation.
Agent→selected option/entity relation; distinct from preference because choice is an act.
Inverse selection relation.
Agent→newly possessed/resource entity relation; distinct from static ownership and receiving.
Agent/entity→lost possession/resource relation; distinct from transfer or defeat.
Agent→target sought relation; distinct from observation and goal.
Agent→found/discovered entity/information relation; distinct from searching and learning.
Agent/event→task/process completion relation; distinct from temporal ENDS_FINISHES as an event boundary.
Agent/tool→opened object/access relation; earlier sparse candidate now has enough cumulative family evidence.
Agent/tool→closed object/access relation.
Agent/tool→locked entity/access relation; distinct from generic fastening/security.
Agent/tool→unlocked entity/access relation; distinct from generic access possession.
Agent/process→constructed artifact/entity relation; narrower than generic creation/production.
Agent/event→destroyed entity relation; stronger than damage.
Agent/material→container/entity filling relation; dynamic counterpart to HAS_CONTENT.
Agent/process→container/content removal relation.
Cause/process→quantity/intensity increase relation.
Cause/process→quantity/intensity decrease relation.
Moving entity→destination arrival relation; distinct from merely having a destination.
Moving entity→source departure relation.
Sender→message/object/recipient transmission relation; distinct from generic transfer and communication.
Inviter→invitee/event/place relation; directed social act.
Host→guest/event relation; distinct from service provision.
Visitor→person/place/event relation; distinct from static location.
Agent→items/group ordering relation; distinct from classification and rank.
Speaker→utterance/recipient relation; narrower than generic communication.
Questioner→recipient/topic relation; distinct from requesting action/service.
Responder→question/questioner relation; narrower than generic response.
Instructor/director→recipient/action relation; distinct from teaching and command.
Advisor→recipient/course-of-action relation; non-command guidance.
Mourner→person/event/loss relation; distinct from conveyed sadness.
Caregiver/tool/treatment→patient/condition relation; distinct from generic care.
Inverse treatment relation.
Provider/caregiver→consumer/dependent nourishment relation.
Inverse nourishment relation.
Agent→skill/activity/goal training relation.
Agent→game/music/performance/activity relation.
Traveler→destination/path relation; distinct from static destination/path.
Entity/person→habitual residence/habitat relation; distinct from current location.
Worker→workplace/domain relation; distinct from WORKS_FOR employer relation.
Rescuer→entity-in-danger; narrower than help/protection.
Inverse rescue relation.
Agent→command/rule/authority compliance relation.
Inverse compliance relation.
Agent/action→rule/norm violation relation.
Agent/institution→recipient/achievement reward relation.
Inverse reward relation.
Agent/institution→subject/action penalty relation.
Inverse punishment relation.
Observer/system→target sustained-observation relation.
Inverse monitoring relation.
Donor→recipient/entity transfer with gifting semantics.
Gift/entity→recipient directed relation.
Friendship relation distinct from generic social bond/partnership.
Companionship distinct from mere co-occurrence or friendship.
Directed experiencer→fear target; distinct from conveying fear.
Agent/role→person/task/outcome responsibility.
Task/person/outcome→responsible agent.
Agent→known situation/entity; distinct from visual observation.
Sign/trace/state→claim/event/condition evidential relation.
Claim/inference→evidence relation; not physical/social support.
Resource/service/entity→potential user availability.
Resource/entity→agent access exclusion.
Entity/system compatibility relation.
Concrete spatial/functional fit relation.
Subject→absent property/part/resource/feature; promotes long-open lack territory.
Container/group/rule→excluded entity/category.
General perceiver→stimulus relation spanning visual/auditory/tactile/etc.; existing OBSERVES_LOOKS_AT only covers visual attention.
Subject→sensory-quality relation (e.g. tactile/visual/scent-like quality) is broader than texture and color and can support cross-modal intersections.
Agent→intended action/outcome relation; purpose belongs to an object, while intention belongs to an agent.
Agent/action→goal/outcome relation; can coexist with intention and purpose.
Entity/agent→possible action/function relation; distinct from what it actually does or is used for.
Event/state→temporal duration relation; not covered by before/after or generic temporal relation.
Event/state→recurrence pattern relation; distinct from sequence and duration.
Entity↔entity/place metric/proximity relation; broad spatial relation exists, but distance is a distinct semantic axis.
Specific proximity relation.
Specific remoteness relation.
Subject/setting→weather/climate/temperature/environment condition; distinct from visible/implied setting.
Subject→social/institutional status relation; distinct from role and encoded identity.

Final phoneme/sound sequence matches.

Orthographic final letter/grapheme matches.

Lexical labels share a suffix.

Lexical form abbreviates another form.
Lexical form is an acronym/initialism of another form.
Lexical form is the singular counterpart of another.
Lexical form is the plural counterpart of another.
Morphologically derived lexical form relation.

Lexical labels have opposed meanings.

Lexical label denotes a narrower semantic class.

Lexical label denotes a whole containing the other's referent/class.

Two labels/forms support a conventional or readily interpretable pun/wordplay relation.
Broad phonological resemblance retained alongside narrower homophone/rhyme relations.
Broad orthographic resemblance retained alongside exact/narrower spelling relations.
Inverse wearer/item relation to WEARS; independently queryable.
Inverse of holding relation; preserve with HAS_OBJECT/HOLDS_CARRIES.
Inverse carrier relation; carrying remains distinct from static holding.
Inverse user/tool relation; preserve alongside USES_OPERATES.
Inverse operator/device relation; operation is narrower than generic use.
Inverse of SUPPORTS; captures physical or structural support direction.
Inverse of COVERS_CONCEALS/COVERS; covering need not imply concealment.
Inverse concealment relation; semantically distinct from mere covering.
Action/signal/object is directed toward a target.
Inverse target relation; entity is target/recipient of directed action.
Directed protector→protected relation; narrower than broad protective relation.
Inverse protected→protector relation.
Directed giver/source→transferred entity/recipient relation.
Directed transfer toward recipient; coexist with RECEIVES.
Directed follower→leader/path relation; distinct from generic sequence.
Inverse following relation.
Directed opposition/resistance relation; narrower than broad conflict.
Specific cooperative relation; preserve alongside broad cooperation/social bond.
Explicit similarity predicate; preserve alongside existing SIMILAR_TO if normalization later distinguishes naming/provenance.
Explicit difference relation; distinct from CONTRASTS_WITH.
Explicit non-attachment/separation relation, counterpart to IS_ATTACHED_TO.
Creator/producer→product relation now has enough repeated source-language support to promote the earlier open creator-product family.
Product→creator/producer inverse relation.
Cause→effect relation is semantically fundamental and source signals recur; preserve despite some explanatory-prose noise.
Effect→cause inverse relation.
Agent/event/state→damaged entity relation.
Inverse damage relation.
Agent/tool/action→repaired entity relation.
Inverse repair relation.
Consumer→consumed entity/resource relation; previously open candidate now promoted.
Consumed entity/resource→consumer inverse relation.
Subject→needed entity/state relation; preserve alongside general REQUIRES_DEPENDS_ON.
Inverse requirement relation.
Teacher/instructor→learner/content relation.
Learner→teacher/source/content relation.
Label/name/sign→referent relation; distinct from DENOTES because naming is an explicit labeling act/relation.
Referent→label/name inverse relation.
Explicit equivalence relation; distinct from similarity.
Directional comparative quantity relation.
Inverse comparative quantity relation.
Subject/material/concept→source derivation relation; narrower than broad source/origin.
Source→derived entity/material/concept inverse relation.
Benefactor/action/resource↔beneficiary relation; distinct from helping, providing, or receiving.
Entity/state/action makes another action/state possible or permitted; distinct from normative permission alone.
Entity/state/action constrains or prevents another action/state; broad enough to include physical and functional restriction while normative prohibition may also coexist.
One entity/sign stands in place of another entity/sign; distinct from resemblance and representation.
Dependency/requirement between entities, actions, or states; retained alongside social dependency because this is general semantic dependency.
Subject is a kind/type/category member of another concept; taxonomic relation.
Subject serves as an instance/example of a broader concept; related to but independently queryable from IS_TYPE_OF.
Inverse of HAS_PART: subject is a constitutive part/component of another entity.
Container↔content relation; distinct from generic HAS_OBJECT and spatial CONTAINS.
Inverse content↔container relation.
Subject/event/material derives or originates from a source/origin.
Movement/action/entity has a destination/endpoint.
Entity acts as a medium/channel for communication or expression; distinct from communicative act itself.
Guidance is a directed social relation and can coexist with support, care, hierarchy, communication, and dependency.
Assistance is a directed relation between helper and beneficiary; it need not imply kinship, dependency, or protection.
Controller↔controlled relation is distinct from the normative concept of regulation itself.
Provider↔resource/service/recipient relation captures provision even outside a transaction.
Recipient↔received entity relation is the inverse/directional counterpart to giving/provision/transfer.
Instrument/sign↔measured or indicated value/state is distinct from generic function.
Agent/tool/event↔modified entity relation captures alteration without requiring a specific transformation outcome.
Carrier/vehicle↔transported entity is distinct from carrying/holding when relocation is the semantic relation.
Entity↔source/container relation for emergence/hatching; can coexist with transformation and spatial containment.
Entity↔group/community relation is more explicit than general affiliation and can coexist with it.
Directional age comparison is distinct from encoded identity or generic comparison.
Inverse directional age comparison; preserve independently under the both rule.
Directional relative-size relation; distinct from HAS_QUANTITY and intrinsic shape/composition.
Inverse directional relative-size relation.
Repeated ownership/possession semantics now justify promoting the previously open candidate.
Inverse possessed-entity→owner relation; independently queryable under directional multiplicity.
Agent/entity moves into a place/container; event relation distinct from static IS_INSIDE.
Agent/entity moves out of a place/container; inverse transition counterpart to entering.
Communicator/sign warns a recipient about hazard/state; narrower than generic communication or indication.
Directed information transfer relation; distinct from requesting and generic communication.
Agent/sign directs another agent/action; narrower than broad social power or communication.
Agent/sign/rule permits an action; narrower than ENABLES_ALLOWS and regulatory relation.
Agent/sign/rule forbids an action; narrower than RESTRICTS_PREVENTS.
Directed caregiver→recipient relation; broad kinship/care relation remains too.
Inverse care-recipient→caregiver relation.
Directed reliance relation; more specific than general dependency.
Worker/professional→institution/client/service relation; distinct from occupational role alone.
Recipient/client→provider relation; inverse perspective to service provision.
Competitive relation is not identical to opposition/conflict and may coexist with both.
Dynamic joining/connection relation; distinct from static IS_CONNECTED_TO.
Dynamic separation relation; distinct from static IS_DETACHED_FROM.
Directed source-state/entity→result-state/entity relation; narrower than broad transformation/transition.
Result-state/entity→source-state/entity provenance relation.
Specific support/spatial relation; coexist with IS_ON and IS_SUPPORTED_BY.
Specific posture/support relation; coexist with pose, IS_ON, and support.
Specific rider→mount/vehicle relation; preserve alongside RIDES and spatial/support relations.
Captures relational spatial topology between entities (inside, on, under, surrounding, adjacent), beyond a subject's own orientation/position.
Captures before/after/first/last/order relations. Kept distinct from general temporal relation because sequence can be ordinal without a clock/date/duration.
Captures adversarial, resistant, competitive, or conflict relations between participants/concepts.
Captures collaboration, coordinated joint action, mutual participation, or teamwork.
Captures giving, receiving, passing, trading, or movement of something between source and recipient. More general than service/transaction.
